name: CRUD page
purpose: List, create, and page records using data-grid, form, dialog, and pagination.
scenarios: Create a record from a dialog form
Show an empty state when no rows exist

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for bundled block copy.

onCreate.description: Called after a record is inserted.

variants.name: density
variants.description: Inherits density from token rungs rather than a local viewport query.

states.name: default
states.description: Table has one or more rows.

antiPatterns: Do not ship a second write path besides install-core when distributing this block.
Do not hide create behind an unlabeled icon.

keyboard: Tab reaches create, grid, and pagination
a11y.focus: Dialog restores trigger focus on close.
a11y.labeling: Grid has an accessible name; create fields have visible labels.

responsive.strategy: Header wraps with flex; grid uses logical inline-size. No viewport media queries.

breakpoints.compact: Header stacks; grid scrolls inside its viewport.
breakpoints.medium: Header sits on one row when space allows.
breakpoints.large: Header sits on one row when space allows.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction comes from locale language.
